_README: Event calendar for MCX event-risk. Recurring events store their NATIVE timezone (America/New_York) and a rule; IST is computed at runtime (DST-aware). Events without a simple weekly/monthly rule (FOMC/CPI/OPEC) are 'override_only' and carry NO fabricated dates — add dated overrides (from the official source) to activate them. Overrides also mark delayed/cancelled/one-off. This is a CALENDAR + EXPOSURE guard only: it never infers bullish/bearish from a release.
